messages:
Maya: Heads-up — after yesterday's EU-Central infra rollout (kernel 6.1.21 + OFED 5.6.1 + EFA fw 2.3.1) we're seeing NCCL allreduce bandwidth drop on p4-style nodes from ~150GB/s to ~65-80GB/s for 8x A100 jobs.

Jon: Ugh. Any specific nodes/ASGs? logs?

Maya: Mostly eu-central-1-gpupool-3, started at ~02:15 UTC. Job ids: run-9876, run-9881. Here's quick iperf between two GPUs (same host vs cross-host):
```
# same host: 140-155 GB/s
# cross host: 65-80 GB/s
```

Sahil: Did we change MTU or enable GRO/LSO offload? Sometimes PMTU/clamping + jumbo frames cause partial blackhole.

Maya: MTU unchanged at 9000. ethtool shows GRO/TSO on. But noticed rx_ierrors ticked up on envoy on one NIC.

Lina: Check `sudo ethtool -S ens5f0` and `rdma link show` for packet drops on the RDMA device. Also grep dmesg for mlx5 errors.

Maya: ran that: `mlx5_core 0000:81:00.0: NIC firmware page size mismatch` logs show FW warnings and a couple of `mlx5_core` entries.

Oscar: That FW message smells like incompatible EFA fw + current OFED combo. Which OFED package exactly?

Maya: OFED 5.6.1-rc1 (we shipped the -rc earlier). Kernel module `mlx5` shows version 5.15.1.

Sahil: RC OFED + fw bump could expose a kernel module change that affects RX coalescing. Anything in `/sys/module/mlx5_core/parameters` changed? Also check `netdev_max_backlog`.

Maya: `netdev_max_backlog` default. We tried toggling LRO/GRO off per host and retested — small improvement but still ~20% below baseline.

Jon: Could be NCCL falling back from IB to TCP due to path migration. Check `NCCL_DEBUG=INFO` logs and `nvidia-smi topo -m`.

Maya: topo shows IB links up. NCCL logs have odd lines: `Transport fallback: rdma -> tcp` and intermittent `IB registers failed` entries.

Lina: Reproduce with `nccl-tests` and `ib_read_bw` to separate RDMA vs NCCL. Also run `ibv_devinfo` and `ib_read_lat` to rule out QP limits.

Maya: `ib_read_bw` shows ~75% of expected cross-host, same-host okay. `ibv_devinfo` doesn't show obvious resource caps. Full logs and perf traces: https://gist.github.com/redwood/abc123

Oscar: Rollback options? (A) rollback OFED to 5.5.x, (B) rollback EFA fw to 2.2.7, (C) pin kernel to previous minor.

Sahil: Prefer minimal blast radius. Plan: canary rollback of OFED on a single ASG + run nccl-tests. If that fixes, isolate OFED. If not, try fw rollback on a rack.

Maya: I can schedule a canary for eu-central-1-gpupool-3b (12 nodes) in the next maintenance window. ETA 45m.

Jon: Also open a vendor case with `mlx5` logs and the fw mismatch lines. I'll create the ticket and paste the number.

Lina: Add perf tracing with `tcpdump -w` on RDMA lanes and collect `perf trace -e mlx5*` during the test so vendor has syscall+driver context.

Maya: Tasks: canary rollback OFED (maya), collect nccl/ib tests + traces (lina), vendor ticket (jon), fw rollback plan (oscar). I'll update after canary. :thumbsup: 

infra-bot: scheduled maintenance window for eu-central-1-gpupool-3b at 2026-03-18T03:00:00Z

Maya: Canary done — rolled back OFED to 5.5.2 on 3 nodes, nccl benchmark back to 145-150GB/s. Looks like the OFED RC was the culprit. Proceeding with staggered rollback after approvals.

Sahil: Nice. Schedule staggered rollback with 2% of fleet per hour and monitor SLOs. Create alert if any node deviates >10%.

Jon: Vendor ticket #INC-2026-214 created and attached logs.

Maya: Rolling out now, will update when done. :eyes:
